1.3.0.en: Plenty of fixed, it has been a good year since this app got some love

1.4.3.en: Minor fixes for login and adding devices

1.4.6.en: Fixes to hostname, login and decos. changed default query time to 30s to relese pain on decos

1.4.7.en: Fix crash on startup when two devices get HTTP 403 due to Deco session limit; devices now re-authenticate automatically on next poll

1.4.8.en: Fix crash on client list, fix false WAN disconnected alarm, and stagger startup polling to resolve permanent 403 session-limit loop on multi-device setups

1.4.9.en: Fix permanent 403 session loop (shared single login across all nodes), remove stale CPU/RAM tiles from satellite nodes, map signal strength 1/2/3 to Weak/Good/Strong labels

1.4.10.en: Remove WAN disconnected alarm from satellite nodes (was showing "-"); map backhaul connection labels to readable WiFi 2.4 GHz / WiFi 5 GHz / Wired

1.4.14.en: Better handeling of login, improved client handeling when no devices on the accesspoint.

1.4.16.en: Small changes to the decryption of the keys in the login

1.4.18.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.19.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.20.en: Added three new flow cards: 'Any client changed status' (fires for any device without pre-selecting a specific client), 'A new client connected for the first time' (fires once per device ever seen), and 'A client changed Deco node' (fires when a specific client roams between Deco nodes, showing old and new node names).

1.4.21.en: Added two dashboard widgets: 'Client Presence' (shows online/offline status, Deco node, and last-seen time for any tracked device) and 'Network Throughput' (shows live download/upload speeds and connected client count across the mesh).

1.4.27.en: Fix LTE MB capabilities showing fractional values in insights

1.4.30.en: Improves logging when Failed to... while connecting

1.4.33.en: Fix Client Presence widget showing a spinning icon when no MAC address is configured

1.4.34.en: Fix Client Presence widget showing a spinning icon when no MAC address is configured

1.4.35.en: Fixed login failure on X50 and X55 routers running firmware 1.8.0 or newer. These models require a different request format during authentication — the app was sending the wrong format, which caused the router to reject the login with a misleading "Wrong password" error even when the password was correct. Reduced unnecessary background API calls on non-LTE models and X50-5G routers.

1.4.36.en: Fixed login on routers that reject the JSON body format immediately after a firmware Lua crash (added a short recovery delay before retrying). Added LTE/5G capability support for X50-5G and other 5G NR models that use the 'nr_intf_cfg' endpoint. Added a login diagnostic view: when a Deco model uses an unknown login protocol, pairing now shows which formats were tried and lets the user copy a ready-to-paste GitHub issue report including model and firmware version.

1.4.37.en: Added mesh-wide client presence: new "client joined/left the Deco Mesh" triggers and a  "client is present in the Deco Mesh" condition. These track a client across all Deco nodes at once, so roaming between nodes no longer causes false online/offline flips in flows. Fixed a misleading "unrecognised login protocol" error that could appear when re-pairing right after deleting devices — this was actually the router's previous session not yet being released, so pairing now retries automatically before showing that screen.

1.4.42.en: Fixed pairing getting stuck on "Loading" after a successful login. Extended the retry window for routers that take longer to release a previous session, so pairing and repair succeed more often without manual retries. Fixed crash and error reports not reaching our monitoring, so issues can now be diagnosed and fixed faster.

1.4.43.en: Fixed pairing/repair failing with a "previous session is still active" error when other Deco nodes from the same mesh were already added — pairing now shares the same login session as your existing devices instead of competing with them for the router's single session slot.

1.4.44.en: Fixed mesh-wide client presence ("client joined/left the Deco Mesh") failing to detect any clients on most models — it now builds the mesh-wide view from data already being collected, instead of a request the router was rejecting.

1.4.45.en: Improved the "previous session is still active" pairing error to explain the most common cause — the TP-Link Deco app or its web admin page being logged in elsewhere (phone or browser) — so it's clearer what to actually do about it.

1.4.46.en: Added a Pause/resume polling control so you can stop API calls to your Deco without removing the device — useful while troubleshooting a session conflict, or to reduce load on routers that struggle with frequent polling. The session-conflict error message now also mentions the TP-Link Deco app's separate "Manager" account, which avoids the conflict entirely.

1.4.47.en: Fixed the new polling toggle being backwards — the switch now lights up when polling is active (running), instead of when it's paused.

1.4.48.en: Fixed pairing crashing with "cannot read properties of null" when the device list couldn't be retrieved (e.g. after a login/network failure during pairing) — it now shows an empty list instead of crashing the pairing screen.

1.4.49.en: Fixed devices failing to start up ("ready_timeout") when the router was slow or temporarily unreachable — login now happens just before the first scheduled check instead of blocking the device's startup.

1.4.50.en: Sped up login by trying the connection format that real Deco firmware actually uses first, instead of guessing wrong and retrying — fewer login attempts hit your router during pairing, which should also reduce "previous session is still active" errors.

1.4.51.en: Removed a confusing extra "Continue" button on the pairing login screen that could skip the login step entirely and crash pairing — you should now only see the "Login" button there.

1.4.52.en: Login requests now match what a real browser sends to your Deco's admin page more closely, which may resolve some remaining "no such callback" login errors on certain firmware.

1.4.53.en: Diagnostic reports now include the exact request headers sent during login, making it easier to troubleshoot connection issues without needing a separate browser capture.

1.4.54.en: Now anonymously reports which login method worked for your Deco model and firmware, helping us spot patterns across different devices over time.

1.4.55.en: Added missing translations to a few flow card menus (no user-visible behavior change).

1.4.56.en: Fixed a rare silent app crash during pairing introduced in a previous fix — a pairing-screen navigation hiccup could, in some cases, crash the entire app without any error being logged.

1.4.57.en: Fixed the "unrecognised login protocol" pairing screen getting stuck on "Loading…", with the Copy debug report and Back to login buttons doing nothing — they were using an outdated communication method that no longer works.

1.4.58.en: Fixed the "unrecognised login protocol" pairing screen showing a hard error popup ("Homey.emit is not a function") on the web/desktop pairing flow — that screen now degrades gracefully on every platform instead of crashing the dialog.

1.4.59.en: Fixed a regression from v1.4.50 that broke pairing for some models (e.g. X50-4G) that worked fine in earlier versions — the app was guessing the wrong login format on the first attempt for these models, causing pairing to fail with "unrecognised login protocol" instead of just trying the other format automatically.

1.4.60.en: Rebuilt login format detection during pairing to try every known login format for your Deco model instead of guessing one and only retrying on specific error patterns — this should resolve "unrecognised login protocol" failures across more models and firmware versions going forward, including ones that don't fail in a way the app previously recognised.

1.4.61.en: Fixed pairing succeeding but never showing your devices to add — login was working correctly, but a pairing-screen navigation bug sent you back to the login screen or the wrong screen instead of the device list. This affected every successful pairing since v1.4.51.

1.4.62.en: Fixed pairing showing a "Timeout after 30000ms" error on slow routers even when login was about to succeed — a network request could hang well past its intended timeout. Login now gives up and reports a clear error well before Homey's own pairing screen times out, instead of silently running past it.

1.4.63.en: Slowed down login format detection during pairing — trying several login formats back-to-back with no delay could look like a brute-force attempt to your router's security and trigger a temporary lockout (showing as a persistent "session limit" error). Login now paces these attempts out.

1.4.64.en: Sped up first-time pairing by trying the login format that real Deco firmware actually uses most often first, based on real browser captures and data from many users' devices, instead of the less common format — fewer wasted login attempts per pairing.

1.4.65.en: Wrong-password errors during pairing now tell you how many login attempts you have left before your Deco locks out further tries, instead of a generic "wrong password" message.

1.4.66.en: Quieted diagnostic logs: detecting whether a Deco model supports cellular (LTE/5G) capabilities was logging an error for every endpoint that model doesn't support, even though that's the expected outcome on most non-cellular models. No functional change — diagnostic reports are just easier to read now.

1.4.67.en: Fixed pairing showing a "Timeout after 30000ms" error in the middle of an otherwise successful pairing, when the router briefly rejected a login due to a session conflict — the retry-with-backoff logic could take longer than Homey's own pairing timeout, even though it would go on to succeed. Pairing now gives up with a clear message well before that timeout instead of running past it.

1.4.68.en: Fixed pairing getting permanently stuck retrying the wrong login format after a router session-limit rejection, instead of giving the correct format (confirmed by a successful browser login capture) a fair chance on the next retry.

1.4.69.en: Reverted a loading screen added in 1.4.68 for the login step — it caused pairing to get stuck right after entering your hostname and password, with no way to continue. Login now works the same way it did before that change.

1.4.70.en: A large fix release built from your reports. Pairing no longer bounces back to the add-device screen with no error — there were two separate causes. Repeated failed logins no longer lock you out of your own router, and the login screen now says which address and password to enter. Decos that stop responding are retried gently instead of continuously, devices show as unavailable rather than displaying stale values, presence no longer flickers on and off, and polling is spread out and slowed down so the app puts far less load on your router. Also: the diagnostic screen and widgets no longer get stuck loading, and your router password no longer appears in diagnostic logs.

1.4.71.en: Various changes from the community feedback

1.4.72.en: Fixed a case where pressing Log in on the pairing screen did nothing at all, with no error shown — a JS error while the screen was loading could leave the button with no click handler. This is now caught and shown on screen, and reported so it appears in your diagnostic report if it happens again.
